# Planik

> Planik is an all-in-one fitness companion for planning workouts, tracking diet, scanning food, and monitoring progress across iOS, Android, and the web.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Personal fitness dashboard with daily summary.
- [Exercises](/exercises): Browse the full exercise library.
- [Body Map](/body-map): Interactive muscle map for targeted training.
- [Templates](/templates): Prebuilt workout plan templates.
- [Create Plan](/create-plan): Build a custom workout plan.
- [Progress](/progress): Charts and trends for workouts and body metrics.
- [History](/history): Past workout sessions and stats.
- [Diet Tracker](/diet-tracker): Log meals, scan barcodes, and recognize food with AI.
- [Help](/help): FAQs and support.
- [Demo](/demo): Authentication demo experience.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account sign in and sign up.
- [Profile](/profile): User profile settings.
- [Settings](/settings): App preferences.
